title: Combat Academy
description: You were invited to attend the Combat Academy, a prestigious institute dedicated to honing the combat potential of talented and hard working students. Whether it be through magic or weapon, the tutelage and practice should help you ascend the ranks within the school system.
prompt: This world is a harsh one. Everyone is expected to hold their own. Our government has funded the Combat Academy to produce as many S-Ranking Students as possible by the end of the year. ${What is your name?}, a ${What gender are you?(Male or Female)} ${What race are you?(Human, Half Elf or Half Demon)} with ${Describe your appearance:} was born into this world, coming from a ${What mana do you have?(Fire Mana, Water Mana, Wind Mana, Earth Mana, Lightning Mana, Ice Mana, Dark Mana, Light Mana, Death Mana, Life Mana, Manaless)} lineage and wielding ${What weapon do you favor?(Sword, No Weapon, Etc...)}, has been selected to attend this prestigious institute. You've honed your ${What is the name of your technique?}, and despite starting as an F-Ranked student, you hope to one day become S-Rank.
authorsNote:
Core rules:
- Battles, Matches, Challenges and Spars Should Last 5 Turns
- Battles, Matches, Challenges and Spars End after 5 turns
- Academy Day must contain Book Studies, Sparring, lunch and Free Period
- Write avoiding summaries & repeating & cliches & unnecessary descriptions
- Let ${What is your name?} take injuries
- Avoid dragging scenes
- Always write second person
- Trigger Second Stage Mana Evolution when hardship is overcame if unachieved
instructions:
You are AI DM providing RPG

- Be specific & terse & imaginative
- Express emotion through physical cues and behavior
- Complete unfinished sentences
- Assume strangers
- Ensure failure & adversity & conflict
- Write dynamic combat utilizing tactics & powers & weaknesses & environmental factors; highlight contributions and impacts
- > denotes action attempts
- Higher ranked Students should normally win against lower rank students
- Lower ranked Students have small chance to win against higher ranked students if within 2 ranks
- Battles, Matches, Challenges and Spars Should Last 5 Turns
- Battles, Matches, Challenges and Spars End after 5 turns
- Any combination of Attacks, Feints, Parries, Blocks and Dodges count for 1 turn
- Turn Count Resets When Battle Ends
- Initiate Student battles regularly
- Create Unique and Dynamic Combat Styles
- Write conveying kinesthetics and tone
- Conversation matches individuals personality
- Write realistic style for conversation
- Individuals do not repeat dialogue
- Individuals tone matches current emotions
- Unrealistic player actions fail, describe when
summary:
You were invited to attend the Combat Academy, a prestigious institute dedicated to honing the combat potential of talented and hard working students. Whether it be through mana or weapon, the complexity of the Mana System should help you ascend the ranks within the Academy.

Every student is given a combat ranking starting from Rank F to Rank S. You are given one based off combat potential and experience during the 1st day of orientation.

cardPool.title: Manaless
cardPool.value: The Manaless are individuals in the world who are born without the ability to produce mana. Those still choosing to live a life of combat often use weapons imbued with mana or tools to make up for their lack of mana. They are the only humans capable of using Anti-Mana. They are often marginalized by those who view mana ability as a sign of superiority.

cardPool.title: Life Mana
cardPool.value: Life Mana is a rare and potent form of mana that is said to be the source of all living things. It is highly sought after for its ability to heal, rejuvenate, and may even grant those blessed by it resurrection when harnessed correctly. Weak to Fire Mana and Death Mana. Resistant to Light Mana and Nature Mana.

cardPool.title: Death Mana
cardPool.value: The Death Mana is an ancient, vile and mysterious force that emanates from the realms of the deceased. This wretched and volatile form of mana is rumored to have the power to curse, drain life, and bring about decay. Weak to Light Mana and Fire Mana, effective against Life Mana and Nature Mana. Resistant to Dark Mana.

cardPool.title: Light Mana
cardPool.value: The purest form of mana said to be harnessed from the blessings of celestial beings. It is often associated with enhancement, protection, purification and is highly sought after by defenders and holy figures. Resistant to Nature Mana and Life Mana. Weak to Dark Mana. Effective against and Death Mana.

cardPool.title: Fire Mana
cardPool.value: Fire Mana is a powerful form of mana, associated with the element of fire. It is said to be channeled from the heart of destruction and is known to be bestowed to individuals of great passion and tenacity. Weak to Water Mana and Earth Mana. Resistant to Wind Mana and Ice Mana. Effective against Nature Mana, Life mana, and Death Mana.

cardPool.title: Dark Mana
cardPool.value: Dark Mana is a formidable and mysterious Mana source that has long been feared and revered. It is often associated with Dark Energy, stealth and illusions.  Often used by tricksters or assassins, it is effective against Light Mana. Weak to Nature Mana. Resistant to Death Mana.

cardPool.title: Water Mana
cardPool.value: Water Mana is a powerful source of energy that allows those chosen by it to manipulate water. It embodies fluidity, adaptability and it is said to be deeply connected to the flow of emotions, making it both tranquil and turbulent. Effective against Fire Mana and Earth Mana. Resistant to Ice Mana. Weak to Lightning Mana.

cardPool.title: Lightning Mana
cardPool.value: A powerful form of mana that crackles with electricity. It holds the potential for both great speed, destruction and incredible power. Those who can harness it are often feared and respected for their ability to wield the power of thunder and lightning. Weak to Earth Mana. Resistant to Wind Mana and Fire Mana. Effective against Water Mana.

cardPool.title: Ice Mana
cardPool.value: Ice Mana is a rare and powerful type of mana found in only a few individuals. It is said to grant users the ability to freeze their enemies and manipulate cold temperatures at will. Effective against Earth Mana and Nature Mana. Resistant to Water Mana. Weak to Fire Mana.

cardPool.title: Wind Mana
cardPool.value: Wind mana is an elemental energy that is attuned to the power of air and movement. It is said to flow freely through the skies, granting those who harness it the ability to manipulate gusts of wind and soar through the air with ease. Resistant to Lightning Mana.

cardPool.title: Earth Mana
cardPool.value: An ancient and powerful form of mana that is deeply connected to the ground, rock, and stone of the world. It is often sought after for its potent and stable energy, reliable in many circumstances. Weak to Water Mana and Ice mana. Effective against and resists Fire mana and Lightning Mana and Resists Nature Mana.

cardPool.title: Nature Mana
cardPool.value: A type of mana that is closely connected to the sentience flowing through the plants, animals, and creatures of the world. It is often sought after by druids and nature-aligned spellcasters for its potent and harmonious energy. Effective against Dark Mana. Weak to Fire Mana, Death Mana. Resistant to Earth Mana, Wind Mana, Water Mana, Light Mana and Life Mana.

cardPool.title: Divine Mana
cardPool.value: Divine mana is an incredibly rare and extraordinary power limited to only the Gods or those with their blood. Those with it are said to have access to every type of mana, and are dangerous, talented and blessed. Resistant to all common forms of Mana Alignments. Unique or advanced Mana Alignments can bypass it's protection.

cardPool.title: Human
cardPool.value: Humans are a diverse and adaptable race, known for their incredible capacity for innovation and their complex social structures. They are found in every corner of the world, building bustling cities and cultivating the land. Their rich history is filled with tales of triumph and tragedy, making them a resilient and enduring force in the world.

cardPool.title: Half Elf
cardPool.value: Half elves are the result of the union between humans and elves. They inherit the best qualities of both races - the adaptability and ambition of humans, and the grace and natural attunement to mana of elves. Has an innate boost to Light Mana, Life Mana, Water Mana, Nature Mana, Earth Mana and Wind Mana.

cardPool.title: Half Demon
cardPool.value: Half demons are the result of a union between a demon and a mortal being. They possess high mana pools and have a mix of human and demonic traits, often struggling with their dual nature and the prejudices of both societies. They are physically stronger than other races and have an innate boost to Fire Mana, Dark Mana and Death Mana.

cardPool.title: Born
cardPool.value:
Born is a powerful half demon student residing in the Combat Academy.  Has Blue hair and golden eyes. He is confident, assertive and has an insane potential. He has achieved Second Stage Mana Evolution, making the Fire Mana he posses a unique color. His flames are blue and black due to the secondary Dark mana alignment. The more his emotions flare, the stronger the intensity of the black flames. When this happens, he likes to shape his flames into a scythe.

Born will dodge, block or parry with his flames in battle.
Born will negate any attempt to kill him.
cardPool.description: Born is known as the strongest S-Rank student at the academy.

cardPool.title: Shiki
cardPool.value:
Name: Shiki
Personality: Nonchalant
Information: Male, Human, Water Mana Alignment, E-Rank Student.
can achieve Second Stage Mana Evolution.

cardPool.title: Lygn
cardPool.value: A Powerful human student of the Combat Academy. He is often seen by himself or with other S-Rank students. Many do not know his mana alignment but assume it is Shadow mana and another Mana speculated to be a unique, known as Nerve Mana. Not many people know about him or how helpful he can be.

cardPool.title: First Stage
cardPool.value: The 1st Stage of Mana Evolution is a crucial step in unlocking one's true potential as a mana wielder. It involves harnessing and channeling raw mana energy, allowing the wielder to cast basic spells and form a connection with the magical forces of the world. This is a naturally done when obtaining a mana alignment.

cardPool.title: Second Stage
cardPool.value:
The Second Stage of Mana Evolution is a critical milestone for any magic practitioner. It signifies the awakening of deeper magical abilities and a stronger connection to the flow of mana in the world.
When this happens, the main mana alignment gains a secondary mana alignment. The two Combine, creating a new unique ability while retaining traces of the original mana alignment.

cardPool.title: Mana
cardPool.value: Mana is the mysterious force that fuels all magical abilities within the World and Combat Academy. It is drawn from the very fabric of the world and channeled through spellcasting, enchantments, and other mystical phenomena.

cardPool.title: Mana Overdrive
cardPool.value: Mana Overdrive is a rare phenomenon that occurs when a combatant taps into an immense reserve of magical energy. This surge of power allows the individual to perform extraordinary feats of magic, unleashing devastating spells or enhancing physical abilities to superhuman levels. However, the strain on the body and mind is immense, and prolonged use of Mana Overdrive can result in severe exhaustion or even permanent damage to the user's mana reserves.

cardPool.title: Mana Reflection
cardPool.value: Mana Reflection is a rare phenomenon observed in those considered Manaless and gifted. It allows the user to redirect incoming spells or attacks back at their opponents with increased potency with any specific weapon.

cardPool.title: Temporal Mana
cardPool.value: Temporal Mana allows its users to manipulate time by slowing it down or speeding it up. It is also possible to view potential futures, or part of something’s past through short visions. It is highly sought after for its strategic advantages in combat and training. Only 1 out of every 1 million people are born with this Mana. Temporal Mana and Spacial Mana are only weak to each other and Advanced users can even bend time to heal wounds or avoid attacks. Current events see Temporal Mana specialists leading in inter-academy tournaments, showcasing its immense potential.

cardPool.title: Anti-Mana
cardPool.value: The Anti-Mana is a rare and powerful substance that can nullify magical abilities and disrupt mana flow within its vicinity. It is highly sought after by those who seek to counteract the powers of skilled magic users. Can only be wielded by Manaless Humans or Half Demons.

cardPool.title: Rexzo
cardPool.value:
Name: Rexzo
Personality: Patient, Serious
Information: Instuctor, responsible for determining every student's rank in the Combat Academy. Dark Knight, Dark Mana, Living Armor Repair itself, Must be present for any student rank changes.
cardPool.description: An instructor clad in the armor of a Dark Knight. The armor he walks in is said to be alive, able to repair itself, growling and roaring during combat. He is responsible for determining every student's rank in the Combat Academy. Those who wish to update their rank need to ensure he is present. His Mana Alignment is Unknown but speculated to be Death Mana or Dark Mana.

cardPool.title: Eliza
cardPool.value: A student wielding a rapier, given a combat rating of A-Rank. Her Mana Alignment is Wind and upon reaching her second stage, she unlocks light. She can be considered arrogant and obsessed with Rexzo, seeking to always be rank assessed by him. She is rumored to be casted out royalty due to only possessing just Wind Mana, but she is able to conjure a mighty wind beast, capable of creating tornadoes. She has brown hair, blue eyes and wears a silver blue dress with white feathers surrounding it.

cardPool.title: Seth Monochrome
cardPool.value:
Name: Seth
Personality: Overdramatic, Friendly, Sociable
Information: Male, Human, Dark Mana Alignment, B-Rank Student, Twin Daggers.
Appearance: Black Trench Coat, Feather adorned top hat
cardPool.description: A B-rank student known as "the assassin of shadows". He wears a long, black trench coat and a top hat adorned with feathers. His main mana alignment is Dark Mana and through reaching the second stage, he unlocked Wind Mana as a secondary alignment which causes him to reach blinding speeds. He is proficient with twin daggers and fights swiftly and silently, treating sparring matches as assassinations. While he is in reality a friendly and approachable dork, he usually puts up a dark and overdramatic persona, often using gothic poetry and dramatic monologues to leave an impression.

cardPool.title: Mana Combinations
cardPool.value:
There exists specific Mana combinations that can only be obtained through birth when specific parents of certain mana alignments come together.

Fire Mana and Life Mana become Rebirth Mana.
Water Mana and Life Mana become Blood Mana.
Death Mana and Life Mana become Soul Mana.
Light Mana and Dark Mana become Fate Mana.
Light Mana and Life Mana become Angel Mana.
Dark Mana and Death mana become Demonic Mana.
Light Mana and Nature mana become Spirit Mana.
Dark Mana and Divine mana become Eldritch Mana.
Lightning Mana and Wind Mana Become Sound Mana.
Dark Mana and Nature Mana become Shadow Mana.

cardPool.title: Chamber of the First Echo
cardPool.value:
Deep within the Combat Academy lies the Chamber of the First Echo, a revered training ground where the very first students honed their combat skills. It is said that the walls of this chamber hold the echoes of their battles, providing invaluable inspiration to those who train within. It is capable of analyzing the individual entering and able to simulate a personalized training environment for advanced and efficient mana development.

Once entered, an opponent capable of countering your fighting style will can be generated for exactly 8 hours, after which will result in 8 hours of free time, followed by 8 hours of sleep time before an opponent is generated once more. Initially clumsy and slow for new and first time enterers, this opponent will gradually become smarter, stronger, and more tactical as each day progresses. Typically 2nd Stage Mana Evolution or 3rd Stage Mana Evolution can be attained once training is completed, and Training can be exited, paused or resumed at any time.

cardPool.title: The Combat Academy
cardPool.value:
The Combat Academy is a towering fortress of knowledge and combat prowess, nestled in the heart of a sprawling mountain range. The academy boasts state-of-the-art training facilities and a curriculum designed to challenge even the most formidable warriors. It houses some of the most renowned combat instructors and offers a wide array of training facilities, including magical dueling arenas and weapon training grounds.

It host a variety of Classrooms, an indoor and outdoor pool, dormitory rooms for male and female, cafeteria and equipment shopping mart.

cardPool.title: The Assessment Hall
cardPool.value: An examination room used to determine a students current rank within the Combat Academy. Overseen by Rexzo, students come here regularly to find out their rank or to ascend their current rank. The assessment is always catered to the individual for maximum accuracy.

cardPool.title: Students of Royalty
cardPool.value: The Students of Royalty at the Combat Academy are a prestigious group of students from upper noble families with the blood of rulers in their veins. They are known for their refined combat techniques, access to rare, powerful artifacts, and insane mana potential. Members of The Students of Royalty are often condescending, see themselves as natural leaders, and excel in both physical and magical combat.

cardPool.title: Students of Nobility
cardPool.value: The Students of Nobility are a faction within the Combat Academy comprised of young men and women from noble families. With access to resources and powerful connections, they are known for their extravagant equipment and specialized combat training. Many are lacking in physical capability but most make up for it with their mana prowess.

cardPool.title: Common-Born Student
cardPool.value: Common-Born Students are those who come from humble origins, without noble blood or great wealth. They must rely on their determination and skill to make a name for themselves within the Combat Academy. They are the majority in the Combat Academy, but many do not see S-Rank.

cardPool.title: Fate Mana
cardPool.value: Legend has it that Fate Mana is a rare and elusive form of mana that is said to be influenced by the forces of destiny. Those who possess this type of mana are believed to have the ability to manipulate fate itself, altering the course of events in their favor or against their enemies. It is said that those with this form of mana are able to leech the luck of those around them.

cardPool.title: Felix
cardPool.value:
Name: Felix
Personality: Friendly, Sociable
Information: Male, Human, Fate Mana Alignment, S-Rank Student, Mana Revolver, Luck Stealer
cardPool.description: A Common-Born human S-Rank student said to have the highest luck in the entire Combat Academy. People avoid him because he cause terrible misfortune to those nearby. Because of this, it is pretty obvious he has Fate Mana and he always carries his Mana Revolver. Despite his luck, he can be pretty friendly if one can get to know him.

cardPool.title: Chaos Mana
cardPool.value: Chaos Mana is a wild and untamed form of magical energy, often associated with unpredictable and disruptive effects. It is said to draw power from the chaotic forces of the universe, causing reality itself to bend and fluctuate in its presence. Random Mana Alignments tinged in each individual use.

cardPool.title: Tournament of Ascension
cardPool.value: The Tournament of Ascension occurs twice every semester, held at the Combat Academy. One as the midterm, the other as the final exam. Students showcase their combat prowess in a series of challenging battles. It serves as a way for students to earn recognition and climb the ranks within the school system, as well as gain admiration from peers and instructors alike.

cardPool.title: Shadow Mana
cardPool.value: Shadow mana is a mysterious and elusive form of mana that is closely associated with shadow manipulation and secrecy. It is said to possess the power to cloak its user from sight and travel within the world's shadows. It is a coveted source of magic for stealthy and cunning combatants.

cardPool.title: Blood Mana
cardPool.value: Blood mana is a forbidden and dangerous form of magic that involves drawing power from the blood of oneself or living creatures. Those who practice blood mana risk corrupting themselves and are often shunned by the mana community.

cardPool.title: Soul Mana
cardPool.value: Soul Mana is a rare and powerful form of mana that comes from within the essence of a person. It is said to be able to tap into the very core of one's being. It is believed to be deeply linked to the emotions and experiences of an individual, and those who can harness Soul Mana are said to possess great insight and potential for powerful magic.

cardPool.title: Raito
cardPool.value:
Name: Raito
Personality: Arrogant, Soft Side, Ambitious
Information: Male, Human, Lightning Mana Alignment, F-Rank Student, Common Born.
can achieve Second Stage Mana Evolution.
cardPool.description: Raito specializes in Lightning Mana. He is new to the Academy and is an F-Ranker. Like you, he too has a goal to become an S-Ranker and is willing to work hard to obtain it. He is arrogant but deep down he has a soft side. He is common-born but is surprisingly skilled and excess potential despite his rank.

cardPool.title: The Shadow Forest
cardPool.value: A dense forest filled with monsters of unimaginable ferocity. The trees cast shadows so enormous that even during the day, it appears as an unending night. It is notorious to the students of the Combat Academy, and remains mostly unavoided due to its dangers and fears of never coming out alive. The Combat Academy makes sure not to take responsibility for any lives lost within the forest. Students B-Rank and Below do not survive 24 hours in this place.

cardPool.title: Arcturus
cardPool.value: The knowledgeable Vice principal of the Combat Academy. He is patient and lenient with students, but is always efficient in his work and duties. He posses Life Mana for solid regeneration, and his combat style is weaving Mana into melee attacks.

cardPool.title: Nerve Mana
cardPool.value: Nerve Mana is a rare and volatile type of mana that flows through the nervous system of living beings. It is said to grant its wielder unparalleled control over their own body and mind, allowing for enhanced reflexes, heightened awareness, and the ability to push past physical and mental limits. However, it is also known to be extremely taxing on the user's stamina and can lead to burnout if not used with caution.

cardPool.title: Third Stage Mana Evolution
cardPool.value:
The Third Stage Mana Evolution is a rare occurrence that signifies the climax of a mage's magical prowess. When a mage reaches this stage, their mana becomes so finely attuned to their will that it manifests in a third New and Unknown Mana Alignment in the form of a familiar. This familiar is sentient and takes the form of any animal, creature or mythical beast.
Only a few students at the Combat Academy can reach this level of evolution. Born, Lygn, Eliza, Shiki, Rexzo and Arcturus can reach this level.

cardPool.title: Rebirth Mana
cardPool.value: Rebirth Mana is a rare and powerful type of mana that is intrinsic to undoing death. Powerful users of this Mana may bypass death for themselves or for others, however, this is only for as long as the user has Mana. Sealing Mana and Anti-Mana is Effective against this type of Mana.

cardPool.title: Demonic Mana
cardPool.value: The sinister and corrupting force of demonic mana is said to be drawn from the darkest realms beyond our world. Those who wield it risk becoming consumed by its malevolent power, but also gain access to terrifying abilities. its use comes with great risk and temptation. Those who tap into Demonic Mana may find themselves struggling to control its malevolent influence.

cardPool.title: Eldritch Mana
cardPool.value: Eldritch Mana is a rare and enigmatic form of magical energy, often associated with otherworldly beings, ancient entities and are said to be able to manifest abominations into the world. It hums with an eerie, pulsating power that can be harnessed by practitioners for potent and esoteric spells.

cardPool.title: Angel Mana
cardPool.value: Angel Mana is a rare and sacred type of mana that is said to be imbued with the essence of the angels. It is sought after for its Holy, commanding, and absolute properties, often used in divine rituals, powerful enchantments. Those who wield this Mana are said to buff their allies while being in combat. The more the fight, the stronger the buff on their allies.

cardPool.title: Sound Mana
cardPool.value: Sound Mana is a rare and unique form of mana that resonates with the vibrations of sound. It is said to be harnessed by those with an exceptional sense of rhythm and a keen ear for music. Sound Mana can be channeled into powerful sonic attacks or used to manipulate the airwaves for communication and perception.

cardPool.title: Gravity Mana
cardPool.value: Gravity Mana is a rare and powerful form of mana that allows the user to manipulate the forces of gravity. It can be harnessed to increase or decrease the weight of objects, create gravitational fields, or even cause localized distortions in space-time.

cardPool.title: Spirit Mana
cardPool.value: Spirit Mana is a rare and powerful form of mana that is deeply connected to the spiritual realm. It is said to be controlled by individuals with exceptional spiritual awareness and can manifest as ethereal wisps or shimmering energy.  It is highly sought after by magic wielders for its unique ability to tap into the wisdom and guidance of the ancients.

cardPool.title: Aether Mana
cardPool.value: Aether Mana is a rare and potent form of mana said to be alive and brimming with echoes conciousness. It is known as one of the purest form of Mana and is beloved by those deeply connected to life, However, its power is tied to the emotion of the user, so poor emotional control can lead to dangerous backlash.

cardPool.title: Akari
cardPool.value:
Name: Akari
Personality: Kind, Cold Demeanor, Cold during combat.
Information: Female, Human, Ice Mana Alignment, C-Rank Student, Nobility, Katana Made From Her Blood Iron.
can achieve Second Stage Mana Evolution. Will gain Blood Mana.
Appearance: Black Hair, White Highlight, Bright Silver Eyes
cardPool.description: Akari, also known as the Ice Blooded Princess is a C-Rank student that wields a katana crafted with the iron from her blood. She has an Ice Mana Alignment and a cold demeanor, but is a kind and considerate person when not in combat. During combat, she becomes cold, calculated and ruthless. If she ever unlocks her Second Stage Mana Evolution, She'll gain Blood Mana as her secondary Mana Alignment. She has Black hair with a single white highlight and bright silver eyes.

cardPool.title: Skirmish Institute
cardPool.value: The Skirmish Institute is a well known battle academy where hardworking students are trained to hone their combat potential. They rival the Combat Academy in showdowns between the two universities. With their unique Color Ranking system and Rigorous practice, students ascend the ranks within the school system. Students here tend to dislike students of the Combat Academy and want to demonstrate superiority and dominance.

cardPool.title: Fire: Fireball
cardPool.value: The Fire: Fireball is a powerful spell that harnesses the elemental magic of fire. It allows the caster to conjure a sphere of intense flames, launching it towards their target with destructive force.

cardPool.title: Shadow: Shadow Step
cardPool.value: Shadow: Shadow Step is a sophisticated mana skill that allows the user to momentarily merge with shadows, enabling instantaneous teleportation within a limited range. Effective in evading attacks and surprise maneuvers, this skill requires precise control of Shadow Mana. It can be used once every three seconds, with a range of up to ten meters. Mastery of this skill is crucial for those specializing in stealth and agility.

cardPool.title: Lightning: Thunder Cloak
cardPool.value: Lightning: Thunder Cloak allows the user to envelop their body in a crackling aura of electricity. This skill provides both offensive and defensive capabilities, enabling fast strikes and powerful shocks while granting resistance to physical attacks. Requires a minimum of Second Stage Mana Evolution to activate.

cardPool.title: Ice: Ice Wall
cardPool.value: Ice: Ice Wall is a defensive mana skill that allows the user to create a solid wall of ice. This wall can withstand powerful attacks and is particularly effective against physical mana skills. It requires a high concentration of Ice Mana and can be maintained for up to 5 minutes. Students at the Combat Academy often use this skill in defensive tactics during battles.

cardPool.title: Wind: Hurricane Dash
cardPool.value: Wind: Hurricane Dash is an advanced mana skill that allows the user to move at incredible speeds, creating powerful gusts of wind that can knock opponents off balance. This skill requires precise control over Wind Mana and is typically mastered by students at the Combat Academy who have reached at least B-Rank. When activated, the user becomes a blur, leaving behind a trail of turbulent air that can be used to evade attacks or strike from unexpected angles.

cardPool.title: Light: Radiant Shield
cardPool.value: Radiant Shield is a defensive mana skill that conjures a brilliant barrier of light around the user. This shield absorbs a moderate amount of damage before dissipating, providing temporary protection against both physical and magical attacks. It is favored by students who prefer to balance offense with defense and is particularly effective in reflecting dark-based mana attacks.

cardPool.title: Dark: Black Bind
cardPool.value: Dark: Black Bind is a mana skill that allows the user to immobilize their opponent by generating dark mana chains. These chains can ensnare and restrict movement, rendering the opponent helpless. The skill is effective against most physical and magical attacks but can be countered by powerful light-based mana. Students who master Black Bind are often seen as formidable tacticians in combat, able to control the battlefield and outmaneuver their foes.

cardPool.title: Soul: Soul Dissonance
cardPool.value: Soul: Soul Dissonance is an advanced mana skill that connects the caster with their opponent's soul to disrupt the enemy's thoughts and actions. This skill is particularly useful for mind games and strategy during battles, making the opponent question their own abilities. Mastering Soul Dissonance requires deep emotional intelligence and a high degree of control over one's own mana.

cardPool.title: Rival Academy: Mayhem Academia
cardPool.value: Mayhem Academia rivals the Combat Academy in sheer combat prowess and academic rigor. It emphasizes unconventional techniques and unbridled chaos. Students here harness wild, untamed mana that defies the traditional mana systems. Their ranks are based on a 'Mayhem Quotient' which measures both individual strength and strategic unpredictability. Mayhem Academia students frequently engage in duels and mock battles, viewing every fight as an opportunity to perfect their craft. They have a long history of intense showdowns with the Combat Academy, often disrupting events and creating competitive tension between the two schools.

cardPool.title: Mayhem Academia: Lamilia
cardPool.value: Lamilia is the headmistress of Mayhem Academia, the rival institution of the Combat Academy. Known for her eccentric behavior, she has a reputation for pushing students to their limits. Lamilia's combat skills are legendary, with mastery over Chaos Mana and Eldritch Mana. She values individuality and creativity, often encouraging unconventional combat techniques. Despite her chaotic nature, she cares deeply for her students and seeks to foster a unique learning environment that prepares them for the unpredictable challenges of the world.

cardPool.title: Beings of the Shadow Forest
cardPool.value: Beings of the Shadow Forest are unique entities that originated from the dense and mysterious woods bordering the Combat Academy. Unlike other students, they possess bioluminescent markings and communicate through melodic sounds. Known for their unmatched stealth and unparalleled night vision, they excel in shadow-based mana techniques. These beings often prefer solitude, focusing on personal mastery rather than teamwork. Despite their aloof nature, they have a profound respect for nature, which drives them to protect it fiercely. Current events see them forming tentative alliances with Common-Born Students who share their environmental values.

cardPool.title: Spacial Mana
cardPool.value: Spacial Mana governs the manipulation of dimensions and distances, allowing users to warp reality's fabric. Users with this mana may teleport, teleport others, create spatial rifts, or even create portals to their own pocket dimensions unique to only the individual. 1 out of every 1 million people are born with this Mana. Spacial Mana and Temporal Mana are only weak to each other. This rare mana type grants unparalleled versatility, making it especially valued among tactical specialists at the Combat Academy.

cardPool.title: Manaless
cardPool.value: The Manaless are individuals in the world who are born without the ability to produce mana. Those still choosing to live a life of combat often use weapons imbued with mana or tools to make up for their lack of mana. They are often marginalized by those who view mana ability as a sign of superiority.
